statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.SeqConv s (fun n : ℕ => KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f) f
proof:
intro s f hf
have hnon : ∀ k, 0 ≤ KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖f k‖^2 := by
  intro k
  exact mul_nonneg (yui_aux_0001 T gamma R s k).1.le (sq_nonneg _)
let A : ℕ → ℤ → ℝ := fun n k => KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖(KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f-f) k‖^2
have he : ∀ n k, A n k = if |(k : ℝ)| ≤ (n : ℝ) then 0 else KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖f k‖^2 := by
  intro n k
  dsimp [A, KdVPlan.cutoff]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all
have hAn : ∀ n k, 0 ≤ A n k := by
  intro n k
  rw [he]
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact hnon k
have hAle : ∀ n k, A n k ≤ KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖f k‖^2 := by
  intro n k
  rw [he]
  split_ifs
  · exact hnon k
  · exact le_rfl
have hmem := yui_aux_0007 T gamma R s f hf
have hpoint : ∀ k, Tendsto (fun n => A n k) atTop (nhds 0) := by
  intro k
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_ge |(k : ℝ)|
  apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop m] with n hn
  rw [he, if_pos (hm.trans (by exact_mod_cast hn))]
have ht : Tendsto (fun n => ∑' k, A n k) atTop (nhds 0) := by
  simpa using tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence hf hpoint
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n k => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hAn n k)]
      exact hAle n k))
have hnorm : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => KdVPlan.hn s (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f-f)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
  simpa [KdVPlan.hn, A] using Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht
refine ⟨hf, ?_⟩
intro ε hε
obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 (hnorm.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε))
exact ⟨m, fun n hn => ⟨hmem n, (hm n hn).le⟩⟩
